text.intro_en: If you have ever pasted a paragraph into ChatGPT and gotten back something that sounds like a corporate brochure, you already know the difference between a generic AI writing tool and a good one. The good ones do not just write faster - they preserve your voice, follow your instructions, and produce something you would actually publish without rewriting 80% of it. After testing 22 writing-focused AI tools over 60 days on real client work, here is the short list that survived.
text.intro_zh: 如果你曾把一段文字粘贴到 ChatGPT 里，得到的却像企业宣传册，你就已经知道通用 AI 写作工具和好工具的区别了。好的工具不仅写得快——更能保持你的语气、遵循你的指令，产出不用重写 80% 就直接可用的内容。经过 60 天用真实客户项目测试 22 款写作类 AI 工具后，以下是最终胜出的短名单。
text.howto_en: Picking a writing tool comes down to three questions: How long are your typical outputs (a tweet vs a 2,000-word blog post changes the answer)? How important is matching your existing voice? And do you need anything beyond writing (image generation, code, voice)? For most people, the right answer is one general assistant plus one specialized tool.
text.howto_zh: 选择写作工具归结为三个问题：你典型输出的长度是多少（一条推文 vs 一篇 2000 词博客文章，答案不同）？匹配你现有语气有多重要？你是否需要写作之外的能力（图像生成、代码、语音）？对大多数人来说，正确答案是一个通用助手加一个专业工具。

faqs_en.q: What is the best free AI writing tool in 2026?
faqs_en.a: ChatGPT free tier (GPT-4o mini) is the best free option for most writing tasks. For long-form drafting, Claude free tier (Sonnet) is more capable but has stricter rate limits. Both are sufficient for essays, emails, and short articles.

faqs_en.q: Is Claude better than ChatGPT for writing?
faqs_en.a: In our testing, Claude produces more natural-sounding English and is less prone to AI slop patterns. ChatGPT is better at brainstorming and has a richer plugin ecosystem. For pure writing quality, Claude wins by a small margin.

faqs_en.q: How much do AI writing tools cost in 2026?
faqs_en.a: The general assistants are $20/month each. Specialized tools like Jasper ($49-125/month) and Sudowrite ($25/month) are more expensive and have not kept up with the general assistants in our testing. The minimum viable stack is $20-40/month.

faqs_en.q: Can AI writing tools replace a human writer?
faqs_en.a: For drafting, ideation, and first-pass editing, yes - AI tools can replace 50-70% of the work. For voice, original perspective, lived experience, and creative risk, no. The right framing is AI as a writing partner, not AI as a writer.

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年最好的免费 AI 写作工具是什么？
faqs_zh.a: ChatGPT 免费版（GPT-4o mini）是大多数写作任务的最佳免费选择。对于长文起草，Claude 免费版（Sonnet）能力更强但用量限制更严格。两者都足以应对论文、邮件和短文。

faqs_zh.q: Claude 的写作能力比 ChatGPT 更好吗？
faqs_zh.a: 在我们的测试中，Claude 产出更自然的英文，更少出现 AI 套路化表达。ChatGPT 在头脑风暴方面更强，插件生态也更丰富。纯写作质量上，Claude 略微领先。

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年 AI 写作工具的费用是多少？
faqs_zh.a: 通用助手每月 $20。Jasper（$49-125/月）和 Sudowrite（$25/月）等专业工具更贵，但在我们的测试中未能跟上通用助手的步伐。最低可行的工具组合是 $20-40/月。

faqs_zh.q: AI 写作工具能替代人类写作者吗？
faqs_zh.a: 对于起草、构思和初稿编辑，是的——AI 工具可以替代 50-70% 的工作。对于语气、原创视角、真实经历和创意冒险，不能。正确的定位是把 AI 当作写作搭档，而非替代写作者。

image.intro_en: We paid for every major AI image generator in 2026 and generated 100+ test images on each. The gap between technically can make an image and actually produces something I would use is enormous - and it is not always correlated with price. Here is the honest ranking, based on what each tool is genuinely good at rather than what their marketing says.
image.intro_zh: 我们购买了 2026 年所有主流 AI 图像生成器的付费版，在每个上跑了 100+ 张测试图。能做到一张图和产出我敢用的图之间的差距巨大——而且并不总与价格相关。以下是基于每款工具真正擅长的方向、而非营销话术的诚实排名。
image.howto_en: The first question is: do you need a one-off image or a steady production workflow? For one-offs, Midjourney or DALL-E inside ChatGPT are the right defaults. For production (e-commerce, blog headers, social at scale), look at the model style control and pricing-per-image. The second question is whether you need photorealism (Flux), pure aesthetics (Midjourney), or text in images (Ideogram) - these are the three poles that matter.
image.howto_zh: 第一个问题：你需要一张一次性图片还是一个稳定的产出工作流？对于一次性需求，Midjourney 或 ChatGPT 内的 DALL-E 是正确的默认选择。对于量产（电商、博客头图、规模化社交），要看模型的风格控制能力和每张图的价格。第二个问题是你是需要写实摄影（Flux）、纯美学（Midjourney）还是图中文字（Ideogram）——这三个是关键极点。

faqs_en.q: What is the best AI image generator in 2026?
faqs_en.a: There is no single best - it depends on what you are making. Midjourney v7 is best for art and aesthetics, Flux Pro for photorealism, DALL-E 3 for following literal prompts, Ideogram for text-in-image, Stable Diffusion for custom styles and total control.

faqs_en.q: Is Midjourney still the best in 2026?
faqs_en.a: For pure aesthetic quality on a vague prompt, yes. For specific use cases (photorealism, text in images, custom styles), other models are now better. Midjourney v7 is also the easiest to use without prompt engineering.

faqs_en.q: Can I use AI-generated images commercially?
faqs_en.a: It depends on the model. Adobe Firefly is the only major model with a clear commercial license (trained on licensed content). Midjourney, DALL-E, and Stable Diffusion have unresolved legal questions - check the latest terms before using generated images in client work.

faqs_en.q: How much do AI image tools cost?
faqs_en.a: Midjourney is $10-60/month. DALL-E is included with ChatGPT Plus ($20/month). Stable Diffusion is free if you have a GPU, or $0.30-0.50/hour on cloud GPUs. Flux is pay-per-image (~$0.05). Ideogram is free with daily limits or $7-16/month for more.

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年最好的 AI 图像生成器是什么？
faqs_zh.a: 没有单一的最佳——取决于你要做什么。Midjourney v7 最适合艺术和美学，Flux Pro 最适合写实摄影，DALL-E 3 最适合遵循精确提示词，Ideogram 最适合图中文字，Stable Diffusion 最适合自定义风格和完全控制。

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年 Midjourney 还是最好的吗？
faqs_zh.a: 对于模糊提示词的纯美学质量，是的。对于特定使用场景（写实摄影、图中文字、自定义风格），其他模型现在更好。Midjourney v7 也是最容易上手的，无需提示词工程。

faqs_zh.q: AI 生成的图片可以商用吗？
faqs_zh.a: 这取决于模型。Adobe Firefly 是唯一拥有清晰商业许可的主流模型（基于授权内容训练）。Midjourney、DALL-E 和 Stable Diffusion 存在未解决的法律问题——在客户工作中使用生成图像前请查看最新条款。

faqs_zh.q: AI 图像工具多少钱？
faqs_zh.a: Midjourney $10-60/月。DALL-E 随 ChatGPT Plus（$20/月）附带。Stable Diffusion 如果有 GPU 则免费，云 GPU 约 $0.30-0.50/小时。Flux 按张计费（约 $0.05）。Ideogram 免费但有每日限额，或 $7-16/月获得更多用量。

code.intro_en: The honest truth about AI coding tools in 2026: there are only two you should pay for, and the right one depends on whether you live inside your editor or live in a chat. Everything else is either a free trial of one of these two or a wrapper. Here is what we use daily after 90 days of testing on a real production app.
code.intro_zh: 关于 2026 年 AI 编程工具的实话：值得花钱的只有两款，选哪个取决于你是活在编辑器里还是活在聊天窗口里。其他要么是这两款的免费试用版，要么是套壳。以下是我们用真实生产应用测试 90 天后每天都在用的。
code.howto_en: The decision is mostly about workflow shape. If you want tab-to-accept autocomplete that lives inside VS Code, GitHub Copilot is the right pick - especially because it is free for students. If you regularly refactor across files, debug a codebase you do not fully know, or want to chat with your code, Cursor is the only tool that does this well. Many serious developers keep both.
code.howto_zh: 决定主要取决于工作流的形态。如果你想要在 VS Code 内按 Tab 即可接受的自动补全，GitHub Copilot 是正确的选择——尤其是学生免费。如果你经常跨文件重构、调试不熟悉的代码库，或者想跟自己的代码对话，Cursor 是唯一能做好这些的。很多资深开发者两者都留着。

faqs_en.q: What is the best AI coding tool for beginners?
faqs_en.a: GitHub Copilot - it is free for students with a verified email, $10/month otherwise, and lives inside VS Code where most beginners already work. Cursor is more powerful but has a steeper learning curve.

faqs_en.q: Is Cursor worth $20/month?
faqs_en.a: For full-time developers, yes - the multi-file editing and codebase chat cut enough time to pay for itself in the first week. For hobbyists, the free tier of GitHub Copilot is enough.

faqs_en.q: Can AI coding tools replace a developer?
faqs_en.a: No. They are productivity multipliers (25-40% faster on most tasks) but they still produce subtle bugs in security-sensitive code about 5% of the time. Treat them as a fast junior developer who needs code review.

faqs_en.q: What is the best free AI coding tool?
faqs_en.a: GitHub Copilot is free for verified students and open-source maintainers. For everyone else, the free tier of Cursor is enough for hobby projects. Codeium is a good free alternative for autocomplete.

faqs_zh.q: 最适合初学者的 AI 编程工具是什么？
faqs_zh.a: GitHub Copilot——学生凭验证邮箱免费，其他 $10/月，并且内置于大多数初学者已经在用的 VS Code 中。Cursor 功能更强大但学习曲线更陡。

faqs_zh.q: Cursor 值 $20/月吗？
faqs_zh.a: 对于全职开发者，是的——跨文件编辑和代码库对话节省的时间在第一周就能回本。对于业余爱好者，GitHub Copilot 免费版就够用了。

faqs_zh.q: AI 编程工具能替代开发者吗？
faqs_zh.a: 不能。它们是将生产力提升 25-40% 的倍增器，但在安全敏感代码中仍有约 5% 的概率产生隐蔽 bug。把它们当作需要代码审查的快速初级开发者。

faqs_zh.q: 最好的免费 AI 编程工具是什么？
faqs_zh.a: GitHub Copilot 对验证学生和开源维护者免费。对于其他人，Cursor 免费版足够业余项目使用。Codeium 是自动补全的好免费替代品。

video.intro_en: AI video in 2026 is where image generation was in early 2023 - exciting, fast-moving, and genuinely useful for a specific set of use cases. The output is no longer obviously AI for short clips, but long-form narrative is still years away. We tested the tools that actually shipped production-ready video this year - Sora 2, Runway Gen-3, Hailuo, Kling, Pika, Luma and more - ranked by what they are good at: quality, motion coherence, editing workflow, and price. For the full short-form ranking, check our best AI video generators list and the hands-on Runway review.
video.intro_zh: 2026 年的 AI 视频相当于 2023 年初的图像生成阶段——令人兴奋、发展迅猛，且对特定场景真正有用。短视频输出已经看不出明显的 AI 痕迹，但长篇叙事仍需数年。我们实测了今年真正交付可用视频的工具——Sora 2、Runway Gen-3、Hailuo、Kling、Pika、Luma 等——按各自擅长方向排名：质量、动作连贯性、剪辑工作流与价格。 完整短视频排名见我们的 最佳 AI 视频生成器 榜单与 Runway 实测。
video.howto_en: Start with the use case. For a 5-10 second ad clip or social hook, Runway Gen-3 or Pika are the right defaults. For a 20-second cinematic shot, Sora 2 is the quality leader. For animating a still image (the cheapest, highest-ROI use case), Luma Dream Machine is the specialist. For motion-heavy character clips at low cost, Hailuo is our surprise winner on coherence. Most teams end up using 2-3 of these in combination - generate in one, edit and finish in another.
video.howto_zh: 从使用场景出发。对于 5-10 秒的广告片段或社交钩子，Runway Gen-3 或 Pika 是正确的默认选择。对于 20 秒的电影级镜头，Sora 2 是质量领导者。对于让静态图片动起来（最便宜、回报率最高的场景），Luma Dream Machine 是专家。对于低成本、动作密集的角色片段，Hailuo 在连贯性上是我们的意外赢家。大多数团队最终会组合使用 2-3 款——一款生成、另一款剪辑与收尾。

faqs_en.q: What is the best AI video generator in 2026?
faqs_en.a: For highest quality, Sora 2 ($20-200/month). For production workflows, Runway Gen-3 ($15-95/month). For free experimentation, Kling ($0-66/month). For animating stills, Luma Dream Machine ($24-96/month). For social clips, Pika ($10-95/month).

faqs_en.q: Can AI video replace a real camera?
faqs_en.a: Not yet. For 5-10 second clips, AI video is genuinely good enough for ads, social, and prototypes. For anything longer or with real human motion, the artifacts are still visible. Use AI video for what it is good at, not for what it cannot do.

faqs_en.q: How long can AI video clips be in 2026?
faqs_en.a: Sora 2 supports up to 20 seconds at high quality. Runway Gen-3 supports 10 seconds. Most other tools are limited to 4-8 seconds. You can stitch clips together in a video editor for longer sequences.

faqs_en.q: Is AI video cheap?
faqs_en.a: The free tiers are usable for experimentation. Production-quality AI video costs $20-200/month for the tool subscription, plus the time to iterate. For a 60-second ad, budget $50-200 in tool costs and 3-5 hours of iteration time.

faqs_en.q: Is Hailuo a good AI video generator in 2026?
faqs_en.a: Hailuo (MiniMax) is our pick for lively character motion and coherent multi-shot clips at low cost. In side-by-side tests it beat Runway on motion coherence for social shorts, while Runway remains stronger for full editing workflows. Best paired: Hailuo for generation, Runway for post-production.

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年最好的 AI 视频生成器是什么？
faqs_zh.a: 最高质量：Sora 2（$20-200/月）。制作工作流：Runway Gen-3（$15-95/月）。免费实验：Kling（$0-66/月）。让静态图动起来：Luma Dream Machine（$24-96/月）。社交片段：Pika（$10-95/月）。

faqs_zh.q: AI 视频能替代真实摄影机吗？
faqs_zh.a: 还不能。对于 5-10 秒的片段，AI 视频对广告、社交和原型来说确实够用了。对于更长或有真实人体运动的内容，伪影仍然可见。把 AI 视频用在它擅长的领域，而非它做不到的。

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年 AI 视频片段最长能有多久？
faqs_zh.a: Sora 2 支持高达 20 秒高质量输出。Runway Gen-3 支持 10 秒。大多数其他工具限制在 4-8 秒。你可以在视频编辑器中拼接片段以获得更长序列。

faqs_zh.q: AI 视频便宜吗？
faqs_zh.a: 免费版可用于实验。生产级 AI 视频工具订阅 $20-200/月，加上迭代时间。对于一条 60 秒广告，预算约 $50-200 的工具费用和 3-5 小时的迭代时间。

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年 Hailuo 是不错的 AI 视频生成器吗？
faqs_zh.a: Hailuo（MiniMax）是我们推荐的、以低成本生成生动角色动作与连贯多镜头片段的选项。在并排测试中，它在社交短视频的动作连贯性上胜过 Runway，而 Runway 在完整剪辑工作流上仍更强。最佳组合：Hailuo 生成、Runway 后期。

audio.intro_en: AI voice generation crossed the indistinguishable from a real voice actor threshold in late 2025, and the 2026 market is now segmented by use case rather than quality (everyone is good enough for English narration). The differences are in languages, voice cloning, latency, and price-per-character. Here is the honest ranking. Within each tier, the names to know are ElevenLabs and PlayHT for voice, Suno for music, Descript for audio editing, Speechify for text-to-speech reading, and Wondercraft for full podcast production.
audio.intro_zh: AI 语音生成在 2025 年底跨越了与真人配音无法区分的门槛，2026 年的市场按使用场景而非质量来细分（英文旁白大家都不错）。差异在于语言、声音克隆、延迟和每字价格。以下是诚实排名。 每个梯队值得关注的名字：语音用 ElevenLabs 和 PlayHT，音乐用 Suno，音频剪辑用 Descript，文字转语音朗读用 Speechify，播客全流程制作用 Wondercraft。
audio.howto_en: If you are making a podcast, audiobook, or YouTube video, ElevenLabs is the default - the quality is the highest and the free tier is enough to test. If you are building a production app that needs TTS at scale, PlayHT is cheaper at volume. If you need real-time voice for a conversational agent, LMNT or OpenAI Realtime API are the right picks.
audio.howto_zh: 如果你在做播客、有声书或 YouTube 视频，ElevenLabs 是默认选择——质量最高，免费版就够测试用。如果你在构建需要大规模 TTS 的生产应用，PlayHT 在量大时更便宜。如果你需要实时语音用于对话代理，LMNT 或 OpenAI Realtime API 是正确的选择。

faqs_en.q: What is the best AI voice generator in 2026?
faqs_en.a: ElevenLabs for quality, voice cloning, and emotional range. PlayHT for high-volume API use. LMNT for real-time applications. OpenAI Realtime API for conversational agents.

faqs_en.q: Can AI voices replace voice actors?
faqs_en.a: For narration, audiobooks, and most non-emotional content, yes - the quality is indistinguishable from a real voice actor. For songs, extreme emotional range, and specific character voices, no. The ethics of voice cloning also matter - always get consent.

faqs_en.q: How much do AI voice tools cost?
faqs_en.a: ElevenLabs is $5-330/month depending on usage. PlayHT is $31-99/month. OpenAI Realtime is pay-per-use (~$0.06/min input, $0.24/min output). Free tiers exist for experimentation.

faqs_en.q: What is the best free AI voice tool?
faqs_en.a: ElevenLabs free tier (10 minutes/month, watermarked) is enough for short projects. For unlimited use, open-source Whisper + a TTS model on your own hardware is free but requires setup.

faqs_en.q: What is the best AI tool for podcasting in 2026?
faqs_en.a: For recording and transcription, Otter and Fireflies are top choices. For voice generation, ElevenLabs leads on quality and emotional range. For music, Suno and Udio generate complete tracks from a text prompt. Most offer free tiers to get started.

faqs_en.q: How do I choose between ElevenLabs and PlayHT?
faqs_en.a: ElevenLabs is best for quality, voice cloning, and emotional range. PlayHT is better for high-volume API use and team pricing. Test both with the same short script: quality differences are most noticeable on long-form narration.

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年最好的 AI 语音生成器是什么？
faqs_zh.a: ElevenLabs 在质量、声音克隆和情感范围方面最佳。PlayHT 适合高用量 API。LMNT 适合实时应用。OpenAI Realtime API 适合对话代理。

faqs_zh.q: AI 语音能替代配音演员吗？
faqs_zh.a: 对于旁白、有声书和大多数非情感内容，是的——质量与真人配音无法区分。对于歌曲、极端情感和特定角色声音，不能。声音克隆的伦理也很重要——始终获得同意。

faqs_zh.q: AI 语音工具多少钱？
faqs_zh.a: ElevenLabs $5-330/月取决于用量。PlayHT $31-99/月。OpenAI Realtime 按用量计费（约 $0.06/分钟输入，$0.24/分钟输出）。有免费版供实验。

faqs_zh.q: 最好的免费 AI 语音工具是什么？
faqs_zh.a: ElevenLabs 免费版（10 分钟/月，有水印）足够短项目使用。如需无限使用，在自己硬件上部署开源 Whisper + TTS 模型免费但需要配置。

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年最好的 AI 播客工具有哪些？
faqs_zh.a: 录音和转写方面，Otter 与 Fireflies 是热门选择；语音生成方面，ElevenLabs 在音质与情感表现上领先；音乐方面，Suno 和 Udio 可从文字提示生成完整曲目。多数工具都提供免费版方便上手。

faqs_zh.q: ElevenLabs 和 PlayHT 怎么选？
faqs_zh.a: ElevenLabs 在音质、声音克隆和情感表现上最佳；PlayHT 更适合高并发 API 使用和团队定价。建议用同一段短脚本分别测试——长文本朗读时音质差异会更明显。

productivity.intro_en: Productivity is the messiest category in AI - it covers everything from note-taking to scheduling to project management to search. Most productivity AI tools are wrappers around the same 3-4 underlying models with a UI. Here is the small list that genuinely fits into a real workflow, not the ones that just look good in a demo.
productivity.intro_zh: 效率是 AI 中最混乱的类别——涵盖从笔记到日程到项目管理到搜索的一切。大多数效率 AI 工具是底层 3-4 个模型的套壳加一个 UI。以下是真正融入实际工作流的少量工具，不是那些只在演示中好看的。
productivity.howto_en: For most people, the right answer is one general assistant (ChatGPT or Claude) used daily for 2-3 weeks, plus one specialized tool that solves a specific pain point. The specialized tool depends on what you actually do - if you live in Notion, Notion AI. If you do research, Perplexity. The trap is buying 5 productivity tools and using none of them.
productivity.howto_zh: 对大多数人来说，正确答案是一个通用助手（ChatGPT 或 Claude）每天使用 2-3 周，再加一个解决特定痛点的专业工具。专业工具取决于你的实际工作——如果你活在 Notion 里，选 Notion AI。如果你做研究，选 Perplexity。陷阱是买 5 款效率工具但一款都不用。

faqs_en.q: What is the best AI productivity tool?

faqs_en.q: How much should I spend on AI productivity tools?

faqs_en.q: What is the best free AI tool for students?
faqs_en.a: ChatGPT free (GPT-4o mini) for general writing, Perplexity free for research with sources, Claude free for long readings. Together they cover 80% of what you need for free.

faqs_en.q: Is it cheating to use AI for schoolwork?
faqs_en.a: It depends on your school policy. Most schools in 2026 allow AI for editing, brainstorming, and explaining concepts you do not understand. They do not allow AI to write essays you submit as your own. Always check your school specific policy.

faqs_en.q: Can AI help me study?
faqs_en.a: Yes, in many ways: generating flashcards from your notes, explaining difficult concepts in simpler terms, creating practice problems, summarizing long readings, and translating foreign-language sources. The best study AI tools in 2026 are ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Anki for spaced repetition.

faqs_en.q: What is the best AI tool for math homework?
faqs_en.a: Google Gemini (free, 1.5 Flash) is the best for step-by-step math solutions. Photomath is the best for showing work on handwritten problems. For statistics, ChatGPT with the Advanced Data Analysis mode is the right pick.

faqs_zh.q: 最适合学生的免费 AI 工具是什么？
faqs_zh.a: ChatGPT 免费版（GPT-4o mini）用于通用写作，Perplexity 免费版用于带来源的研究，Claude 免费版用于长文阅读。三者结合免费覆盖 80% 的需求。

faqs_zh.q: 用 AI 做作业算作弊吗？
faqs_zh.a: 取决于学校政策。2026 年大多数学校允许用 AI 进行编辑、头脑风暴和解释你不懂的概念。不允许用 AI 写你署名提交的论文。请始终查看你学校的具体政策。

faqs_zh.q: AI 能帮我学习吗？
faqs_zh.a: 能，在很多方面：从笔记生成记忆卡片、用更简单的方式解释难懂概念、创建练习题、总结长文阅读、翻译外语资料。2026 年最好的学习 AI 工具是 ChatGPT、Perplexity 和 Anki（间隔重复）。

faqs_zh.q: 最适合数学作业的 AI 工具是什么？

faqs_en.q: Is Claude better than ChatGPT for writing?
faqs_en.a: In our testing, Claude produces more natural-sounding English and is less prone to AI slop patterns. ChatGPT is better at brainstorming and has a richer plugin ecosystem. For pure writing quality, Claude wins by a small margin.

faqs_en.a: The general assistants are $20/month each. Specialized tools like Jasper ($49-125/month) and Sudowrite ($25/month) are more expensive and have not kept up with the general assistants in our testing. The minimum viable stack is $20-40/month.

faqs_en.q: Can AI writing tools replace a human writer?
faqs_en.a: For drafting, ideation, and first-pass editing, yes - AI tools can replace 50-70% of the work. For voice, original perspective, lived experience, and creative risk, no. The right framing is AI as a writing partner, not AI as a writer.

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年最好的免费 AI 写作工具是什么？
faqs_zh.a: ChatGPT 免费版（GPT-4o mini）是大多数写作任务的最佳免费选择。对于长文起草，Claude 免费版（Sonnet）能力更强但用量限制更严格。两者都足以应对论文、邮件和短文。

faqs_zh.a: 在我们的测试中，Claude 产出更自然的英文，更少出现 AI 套路化表达。ChatGPT 在头脑风暴方面更强，插件生态也更丰富。纯写作质量上，Claude 略微领先。

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年 AI 写作工具的费用是多少？
faqs_zh.a: 通用助手每月 $20。Jasper（$49-125/月）和 Sudowrite（$25/月）等专业工具更贵，但在我们的测试中未能跟上通用助手的步伐。最低可行的工具组合是 $20-40/月。

faqs_zh.a: 对于起草、构思和初稿编辑，是的——AI 工具可以替代 50-70% 的工作。对于语气、原创视角、真实经历和创意冒险，不能。正确的定位是把 AI 当作写作搭档，而非替代写作者。

image-generation.intro_en: We subscribed to every major text-to-image model in 2026 - Midjourney, Flux, Stable Diffusion, Ideogram, Leonardo, DALL-E, ComfyUI - and ran the same 25 prompts on each, scoring photorealism, prompt adherence, text-in-image accuracy, style control, and speed. The result: there is no single best image generator. The right answer depends on what you are making - photoreal product shots, art, graphic design, anime, or posters with accurate text. Here is the honest breakdown by use case. Start with our Stable Diffusion and Krea AI hands-on reviews, then compare full feature sets in the image generator comparison.
image-generation.intro_zh: 我们订阅了 2026 年所有主流文生图模型——Midjourney、Flux、Stable Diffusion、Ideogram、Leonardo、DALL-E、ComfyUI——并在每个模型上运行相同的 25 条提示词，按写真度、提示词遵循度、图中文字准确度、风格控制与速度打分。结果：不存在单一最佳图像生成器。正确答案取决于你要做什么——写实产品图、艺术、平面设计、动漫，还是带准确文字的海报。以下是按使用场景的诚实拆解。 从我们的 Stable Diffusion 与 Krea AI 实测开始，再到 图像生成器对比 中比较完整功能。
image-generation.howto_en: Picking an AI image generator comes down to four questions: do you need photorealism (Flux.1 Pro, Midjourney v7), artistic style control (Midjourney, Ideogram), accurate text-in-image (Ideogram, Flux), or free local generation (Stable Diffusion, ComfyUI)? For most commercial work the answer is one quality model for hero visuals plus one cheap or free model for iteration. In our 25-prompt test, no single tool won every category - so budget for a combo, not a single subscription.
image-generation.howto_zh: 选择 AI 图像生成器归结为四个问题：你需要写真度（Flux.1 Pro、Midjourney v7）、艺术风格控制（Midjourney、Ideogram）、准确的图中文字（Ideogram、Flux），还是免费本地生成（Stable Diffusion、ComfyUI）？对大多数商业工作，答案是一款高质量模型做主视觉、再配一款便宜或免费模型做迭代。在我们的 25 条提示词测试中，没有单一工具赢下所有项目——所以请按组合预算，而非单个订阅。

faqs_en.q: What is the best AI image generator in 2026?
faqs_en.a: For photorealism, Flux.1 Pro and Midjourney v7 lead the pack. For artistic style control, Midjourney and Ideogram. For free local generation, Stable Diffusion with ComfyUI. For quick design iterations, Leonardo and Canva AI. We scored all of them on 25 identical prompts - the winner depends on your use case.

faqs_en.q: Is Midjourney or Stable Diffusion better?
faqs_en.a: Midjourney wins on out-of-the-box aesthetics, prompt adherence and speed; Stable Diffusion wins on control, local privacy and cost (it is free and open source). Most creators keep both: Midjourney for fast client work, Stable Diffusion for precise, reproducible results.

faqs_en.q: How much do AI image generators cost in 2026?
faqs_en.a: Midjourney starts at $10/month; Ideogram and Leonardo sit around $12/month; Flux has a free tier plus Pro credits; Stable Diffusion and ComfyUI are free if you have a decent GPU. A practical toolkit runs $10-40/month.

faqs_en.q: Can AI image generators render text in images?
faqs_en.a: Ideogram and Flux are the clear leaders for accurate text rendering. Midjourney v7 improved noticeably but still struggles with longer strings. If your work is posters, ads or product mockups with text, Ideogram is the safe default.

faqs_en.q: Can I use AI-generated images commercially?
faqs_en.a: Yes on paid plans. Midjourney paid users get commercial rights, and Flux, Ideogram and Leonardo paid tiers allow commercial use. Free tiers vary by tool, so check each license - and disclose AI generation where platform rules require it.

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年最好的 AI 图像生成器是什么？
faqs_zh.a: 写真度：Flux.1 Pro 与 Midjourney v7 领先。艺术风格控制：Midjourney 与 Ideogram。免费本地生成：Stable Diffusion 搭配 ComfyUI。快速设计迭代：Leonardo 与 Canva AI。我们在相同的 25 条提示词上为它们打分——赢家取决于你的使用场景。

faqs_zh.q: Midjourney 和 Stable Diffusion 哪个更好？
faqs_zh.a: Midjourney 在开箱即用的美感、提示词遵循度和速度上胜出；Stable Diffusion 在可控性、本地隐私和成本上胜出（免费且开源）。大多数创作者两个都用：Midjourney 处理快速客户需求，Stable Diffusion 处理精确、可复现的结果。

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年 AI 图像生成器的费用是多少？
faqs_zh.a: Midjourney 从 $10/月起；Ideogram 与 Leonardo 约 $12/月；Flux 有免费版加 Pro 积分；Stable Diffusion 与 ComfyUI 只要有像样的显卡就免费。一套实用组合约 $10-40/月。

faqs_zh.q: AI 图像生成器能渲染图中的文字吗？

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年小企业最好用的 AI 工具有哪些？

faqs_zh.q: 小企业在 AI 工具上应该花多少钱？

ai-for-architects.intro_en: Architecture in 2026 is going through an AI transformation that rivals the shift from hand-drafting to CAD. The tools are no longer just for pretty renderings - they handle code compliance checks, structural optimization, and even client presentations. After testing 18 AI tools across three architecture firms over 45 days, here is the short list that actually integrates into a real architectural workflow.
ai-for-architects.intro_zh: 2026 年的建筑行业正经历一场堪比从手绘到 CAD 转变的 AI 变革。这些工具不再只是用于漂亮的效果图——它们可以处理规范合规检查、结构优化，甚至客户演示。经过 45 天在三个建筑事务所测试 18 款 AI 工具后，以下是真正融入真实建筑工作流的短名单。
ai-for-architects.howto_en: Architects should focus on two categories: visualization tools (Midjourney, Krea, Luma) for concept generation and client communication, and general assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) for specification writing, code research, and documentation. The combination of one visualization tool plus one assistant covers 80% of the benefit.
ai-for-architects.howto_zh: 建筑师应关注两类工具：可视化工具（Midjourney、Krea、Luma）用于概念生成和客户沟通，以及通用助手（ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity）用于规范编写、规范研究和文档编制。一款可视化工具加一款助手的组合覆盖 80% 的收益。

faqs_en.q: Can AI replace architects?
faqs_en.a: No. AI can generate concepts, handle repetitive documentation, and produce renderings 10x faster, but it cannot replace the judgment, creativity, and regulatory understanding that licensed architects provide. Think of AI as a very fast junior architect, not a replacement.

faqs_en.q: What is the best AI rendering tool for architects in 2026?
faqs_en.a: Midjourney v7 is the quality leader for conceptual renderings, Krea is best for real-time iteration on existing designs, and Luma is the specialist for turning 3D models into cinematic walkthroughs. Most firms use all three at different stages.

faqs_en.q: How much do AI tools cost for architects?
faqs_en.a: The minimum viable stack is $50-100/month: Midjourney ($30/month) plus ChatGPT or Claude ($20/month). Adding Krea ($35/month) and Luma ($24/month) brings the total to ~$110/month for a comprehensive setup.

faqs_en.q: Can AI help with building code compliance?
faqs_en.a: Partially. AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude can search building codes and flag potential violations, but they are not substitutes for licensed review. Use them to speed up the first pass, not for final sign-off.

faqs_zh.q: AI 能替代建筑师吗？
faqs_zh.a: 不能。AI 可以生成概念、处理重复性文档、以 10 倍速度产出效果图，但无法替代持证建筑师提供的判断力、创造力和法规理解。把 AI 想象成一个非常快速的初级建筑师，而非替代品。

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年最适合建筑师的 AI 渲染工具是什么？
faqs_zh.a: Midjourney v7 是概念效果图的质量领导者，Krea 最适合在现有设计上实时迭代，Luma 是将 3D 模型转为电影级漫游的专家。大多数事务所会在不同阶段使用全部三款。

faqs_zh.q: 建筑师的 AI 工具需要花多少钱？
faqs_zh.a: 最低可行的工具组合是 $50-100/月：Midjourney（$30/月）加 ChatGPT 或 Claude（$20/月）。加上 Krea（$35/月）和 Luma（$24/月），综合配置约 $110/月。

faqs_zh.q: AI 能帮助建筑规范合规检查吗？
faqs_zh.a: 部分可以。ChatGPT 和 Claude 等 AI 助手可以搜索建筑规范并标记潜在违规问题，但不能替代持证审查。用它们加速首轮检查，而非最终签批。

coding-assistant.intro_en: We tested 14 AI coding assistants over 45 days on production codebases. The gap between a tool that autocompletes a line and one that genuinely understands your architecture is massive. After shipping real features with each tool, here is the honest ranking.
coding-assistant.intro_zh: 我们花了 45 天在生产代码库上测试了 14 款 AI 编程助手。一个能补全一行代码的工具和真正理解你架构的工具之间的差距是巨大的。在每款工具上交付了真实功能后，以下是诚实的排名。
coding-assistant.howto_en: Choosing a coding assistant comes down to three factors: how much context it can hold (whole codebase vs single file), how it handles multi-file refactoring, and whether you need IDE integration (VS Code) or prefer a standalone tool. For most developers, the right stack is one primary assistant plus one terminal-based tool for complex tasks.
coding-assistant.howto_zh: 选择编程助手归结为三个因素：它能承载多少上下文（整个代码库 vs 单个文件）、它如何处理多文件重构、以及你是需要 IDE 集成（VS Code）还是偏好独立工具。对大多数开发者来说，正确的组合是一个主力助手加一个用于复杂任务的终端工具。

faqs_en.q: What is the best free AI coding assistant in 2026?
faqs_en.a: GitHub Copilot free tier and Codeium offer solid autocomplete at no cost. Cursor's free tier gives you 2,000 completions per month with the same models as the paid plan. For students, all three are completely free through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.

faqs_en.q: Is Cursor better than GitHub Copilot?
faqs_en.a: In our testing, Cursor wins on multi-file refactoring and codebase understanding because it indexes your entire project. GitHub Copilot is better for inline autocomplete and has deeper IDE integration. Cursor is our top pick for complex work; Copilot for daily productivity.

faqs_en.q: How much do AI coding assistants cost?
faqs_en.a: Most start at $10-20/month. GitHub Copilot is $10/month, Cursor Pro is $20/month, Windsurf is $15/month. The ROI is clear: most developers report saving 2-5 hours per week.

faqs_en.q: Can AI coding assistants replace junior developers?
faqs_en.a: For boilerplate, tests, and simple features, yes. For architecture decisions, debugging complex systems, and understanding business logic, no. The right framing is AI as a force multiplier for developers, not a replacement.

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年最好的免费 AI 编程助手是什么？
faqs_zh.a: GitHub Copilot 免费版和 Codeium 提供可靠的免费自动补全。Cursor 免费版每月提供 2,000 次补全，模型与付费版相同。学生通过 GitHub Student Developer Pack 可全部免费使用。

faqs_zh.q: Cursor 比 GitHub Copilot 更好吗？
faqs_zh.a: 在我们的测试中，Cursor 在多文件重构和代码库理解方面胜出，因为它索引整个项目。GitHub Copilot 在行内自动补全和 IDE 集成方面更强。复杂工作选 Cursor，日常效率选 Copilot。

faqs_zh.q: AI 编程助手费用是多少？
faqs_zh.a: 大多数从 $10-20/月 起步。GitHub Copilot $10/月，Cursor Pro $20/月，Windsurf $15/月。投资回报明确：大多数开发者报告每周节省 2-5 小时。

faqs_zh.q: AI 编程助手能替代初级开发者吗？
faqs_zh.a: 对于模板代码、测试和简单功能，是的。对于架构决策、复杂系统调试和理解业务逻辑，不能。正确定位是把 AI 当作开发者的效率倍增器，而非替代品。

ai-for-sales-teams.intro_en: We tested 11 AI tools for sales teams over 60 days - running real outreach campaigns, analyzing call transcripts, and automating CRM workflows. The tools that made the cut do not just save time; they increase close rates. Here is what survived real sales pressure.
ai-for-sales-teams.intro_zh: 我们花了 60 天测试了 11 款销售团队 AI 工具——运行真实外联活动、分析通话记录、自动化 CRM 工作流。入选的工具不只是省时间，而是提高成交率。以下是经过真实销售压力考验的结果。
ai-for-sales-teams.howto_en: Sales AI tools fall into three buckets: outreach (email, social), call intelligence (transcription, sentiment, coaching), and automation (CRM sync, follow-ups, pipeline management). Most teams need at least one from each bucket. Start with call intelligence if you do 20+ calls per week; start with outreach if your pipeline is thin.
ai-for-sales-teams.howto_zh: 销售 AI 工具分为三类：外联（邮件、社交媒体）、通话智能（转录、情绪分析、辅导）和自动化（CRM 同步、跟进、管道管理）。大多数团队每类至少需要一个。每周 20+ 通电话从通话智能开始；管道薄弱从外联开始。

faqs_en.q: What is the best AI tool for sales outreach?
faqs_en.a: ChatGPT and Claude are excellent for drafting personalized emails at scale. Jasper and Copy.ai offer specialized sales templates. The key is not the tool but the prompt: include prospect research, pain points, and a single clear ask.

faqs_en.q: Can AI handle sales calls?
faqs_en.a: AI does not make the calls (yet), but it analyzes them brilliantly. Fireflies and Otter transcribe calls and highlight objections, next steps, and sentiment. This alone saves 5-10 hours per rep per week on CRM notes.

faqs_en.q: How much do sales AI tools cost?
faqs_en.a: A complete stack (outreach + call intelligence + automation) costs $50-150/month per seat. The ROI is typically 5-10x within the first quarter through saved time and increased close rates.

faqs_zh.q: 最好的 AI 销售外联工具是什么？
faqs_zh.a: ChatGPT 和 Claude 非常适合规模化撰写个性化邮件。Jasper 和 Copy.ai 提供专业的销售模板。关键不在工具而在提示词：包含潜在客户调研、痛点和单一明确的要求。

faqs_zh.q: AI 能处理销售电话吗？
faqs_zh.a: AI 目前不打销售电话，但分析通话非常出色。Fireflies 和 Otter 转录通话并标注异议、下一步和情绪。仅此一项，每位销售每周就能节省 5-10 小时的 CRM 记录时间。

faqs_zh.q: 销售 AI 工具费用是多少？
faqs_zh.a: 完整工具组合（外联 + 通话智能 + 自动化）每席位 $50-150/月。投资回报通常在第一季度达到 5-10 倍，来自节省的时间和提升的成交率。

ai-for-lawyers.intro_en: Legal work is document-heavy, precision-critical, and billable by the hour. We tested 9 AI tools on real legal workflows - contract review, legal research, deposition summaries, intake automation - across two weeks to find which ones actually reduce hours without reducing quality. This page ranks the survivors for solo practitioners, boutique firms, and in-house teams.
ai-for-lawyers.intro_zh: 法律工作文档繁重、精密度要求高、按小时计费。我们在两周内对 9 款 AI 工具在真实法律工作流上做了测试——合同审查、法律研究、证词摘要、收案自动化——找出哪些真正减少工时而不降低质量。本页面向独立执业者、精品所与公司法务团队，对存活下来的工具进行排名。
ai-for-lawyers.howto_en: For lawyers, the most impactful AI use cases are: document review (Claude for long contracts, 200K context), legal research (Perplexity and Consensus for case law with citations), and workflow automation (Dify and n8n for intake and document generation pipelines). Test small on one matter type first, keep a human review step, and never put client-confidential data into consumer AI tools without checking the data usage policy.
ai-for-lawyers.howto_zh: 对律师来说，最有价值的 AI 场景是：文档审查（Claude 以 20 万上下文处理长合同）、法律研究（Perplexity 与 Consensus 检索带引用的判例法）和工作流自动化（Dify 与 n8n 构建收案和文档生成流程）。先在单一案件类型上小规模试点、保留人工复核环节，并在未检查数据使用政策前，切勿将客户机密数据输入消费者 AI 工具。

faqs_en.q: Is it safe for lawyers to use AI?
faqs_en.a: Yes, with precautions. Use tools with opt-out data training (Claude Pro, ChatGPT Team) and never input client names or identifying details. For sensitive work, consider self-hosted models via Ollama or enterprise API tiers with zero data retention.

faqs_en.q: What is the best AI for contract review?
faqs_en.a: Claude's 200K context window can ingest a 150-page contract in one go. ChatGPT is better for quick clause comparisons. Neither replaces a lawyer's judgment, but both can flag anomalies and summarize key terms in minutes instead of hours.

faqs_en.q: Can AI write legal documents?
faqs_en.a: AI can draft first versions of common documents (NDAs, engagement letters, simple motions) but these must always be reviewed by a licensed attorney. The time savings come from not starting from a blank page.

faqs_en.q: Which AI tools do lawyers actually use for legal research?
faqs_en.a: In our tests, Perplexity with academic search and Consensus for case-law summaries are the most cited. Both surface sources with citations, which matters for verification. Pair either with a general assistant (Claude or ChatGPT) to draft memos from the research.

faqs_en.q: How much does an AI stack cost for a law firm in 2026?
faqs_en.a: Consumer plans run about $20/month per attorney for ChatGPT or Claude. Legal-specific tools add $25-150/month, and document automation with Dify or n8n is free-to-start and scales with workload. Most solo practices we tested ran a complete stack under $100/month per attorney.

faqs_zh.q: 律师使用 AI 安全吗？
faqs_zh.a: 安全，但需谨慎。使用可关闭数据训练的工具（Claude Pro、ChatGPT Team），绝不输入客户姓名或身份信息。对于敏感工作，考虑通过 Ollama 自部署模型或零数据保留的企业 API。

faqs_zh.q: 最好的 AI 合同审查工具是什么？
faqs_zh.a: Claude 的 20 万上下文窗口可以一次性处理 150 页合同。ChatGPT 更适合快速条款对比。两者都不替代律师的判断，但都能在几分钟内标注异常和总结关键条款，而非数小时。

faqs_zh.q: AI 能撰写法律文件吗？
faqs_zh.a: AI 可以起草常见文件的第一版（保密协议、委托书、简单动议），但这些必须始终由持证律师审核。节省的时间来自不必从空白页开始。

faqs_zh.q: 律师实际上用哪些 AI 工具做法律研究？
faqs_zh.a: 在我们的测试中，Perplexity（学术搜索）与 Consensus（判例法摘要）被引用最多。两者都附来源与引用，这对核验很重要。可将其中一款与通用助手（Claude 或 ChatGPT）搭配，从研究结果起草备忘录。

faqs_zh.q: 2026 年一家律所的 AI 组合成本是多少？
faqs_zh.a: ChatGPT 或 Claude 的消费级套餐约 $20/月/位律师。法律专用工具再加 $25-150/月，用 Dify 或 n8n 做文档自动化则可免费起步、随工作量扩展。我们测试的大多数独立执业者把完整组合控制在每位律师 $100/月以内。

ai-for-doctors.intro_en: Medical professionals face a unique challenge: high-stakes decisions with massive information overflow. We tested 10 AI tools on clinical documentation, literature review, and patient education - focusing on accuracy, privacy, and real clinical utility.
ai-for-doctors.intro_zh: 医疗专业人员面临独特挑战：高风险决策与海量信息过载。我们在临床文档、文献综述和患者教育上测试了 10 款 AI 工具——关注准确性、隐私和真实临床效用。
ai-for-doctors.howto_en: For doctors, AI is most useful in three areas: literature review (Consensus and Elicit for finding evidence-based answers fast), documentation (Otter and Fireflies for clinical note drafting), and patient communication (ChatGPT and Claude for drafting patient-friendly explanations). Never input PHI into consumer AI tools. Use HIPAA-compliant enterprise tiers or on-premise models.
ai-for-doctors.howto_zh: 对医生来说，AI 在三个领域最有用：文献综述（Consensus 和 Elicit 快速查找循证答案）、文档记录（Otter 和 Fireflies 起草临床笔记）和患者沟通（ChatGPT 和 Claude 起草通俗易懂的解释）。切勿将受保护的健康信息输入消费者 AI 工具。使用符合 HIPAA 的企业版或本地部署模型。

faqs_en.q: Is AI reliable for medical research?
faqs_en.a: Tools like Consensus and Elicit search actual peer-reviewed papers and provide citations. They are excellent for quick literature scans but should not replace systematic reviews. Always verify cited sources.

faqs_en.q: Can AI help with clinical documentation?
faqs_en.a: Yes. Fireflies and Otter can transcribe patient conversations (with consent) and generate structured SOAP notes. This saves 1-2 hours per day for most clinicians. However, all AI-generated notes must be reviewed and signed by the provider.

faqs_en.q: What about patient data privacy?
faqs_en.a: This is the most critical concern. Consumer AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude free tiers) are not HIPAA-compliant. Use enterprise tiers with BAA agreements, or self-host models via Ollama. Never enter patient names, MRNs, or identifiable details into any AI tool without a BAA.

faqs_zh.q: AI 用于医学研究可靠吗？
faqs_zh.a: Consensus 和 Elicit 等工具搜索真实的同行评审论文并提供引用。它们非常适合快速文献扫描，但不应替代系统综述。务必验证引用来源。

faqs_zh.q: AI 能帮助临床文档记录吗？
faqs_zh.a: 可以。Fireflies 和 Otter 可以转录患者对话（经同意）并生成结构化的 SOAP 笔记。这为大多数临床医生每天节省 1-2 小时。但所有 AI 生成的笔记必须由医生审核和签署。

faqs_zh.q: 患者数据隐私怎么办？
faqs_zh.a: 这是最关键的问题。消费者 AI 工具（ChatGPT、Claude 免费版）不符合 HIPAA。使用带有 BAA 协议的企业版，或通过 Ollama 自部署模型。绝不在没有 BAA 的情况下将患者姓名、病历号或可识别信息输入任何 AI 工具。
